subject: math

objective.text: Put shapes together to make new shapes. Take a big shape apart into smaller shapes.

source_ref.section: Lesson objective: Combine shapes to create a composite shape; create a new shape from composite shapes.

explanations.title: A tangram is made of polygons
explanations.text: A tangram is a big square cut into 7 polygons. There are triangles, a square and a parallelogram.

source_ref.section: Concept Development Part 1

explanations.title: Big shapes from small shapes
explanations.text: 2 small triangles can make a bigger triangle. We can make large polygons out of smaller ones.

source_ref.section: Concept Development Part 1: 'we can make larger polygons out of smaller ones'

explanations.title: Flip, slide and turn
explanations.text: Move the pieces to make new shapes. You can flip, slide and turn them.

source_ref.section: Concept Development Part 2

examples.title: Two large triangles
examples.text: Put the 2 largest triangles together. You can make a triangle, a square, or a parallelogram with no square corners.
